build.cleaning: Initial clean gap-width=0; schematic closed-gap fill only, sliver-control=0; no close-outer-gaps
build.prepareCommand: -i units.geojson name=units -clean gap-width=0 overlap-rule=min-area -simplify dp interval=150m keep-shapes stats -clean gap-width=0 overlap-rule=min-area -dissolve p,c target=units no-repair copy-fields=p,c + name=cities -dissolve p target=units no-repair copy-fields=p + name=provinces -o target=units,cities,provinces format=topojson no-quantization prepared.json
build.finishCommand: -i schematic.topojson name=units -clean gap-fill-area=50km2 sliver-control=0 overlap-rule=min-area -dissolve p,c target=units no-repair copy-fields=p,c + name=cities -dissolve p target=units no-repair copy-fields=p + name=provinces -filter "countyUnavailable !== true" target=units name=counties -o target=counties,cities,provinces format=topojson quantization=10000000 fix-geometry display.json

schematic.authorizedPurpose: User-requested footprint illustration; display reassignment only
schematic.rule: Remove hole-free non-primary county components only when every exterior arc is shared by exactly two counties; protect all primary components, parent primaries, coastal components and Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan; fill closed gaps up to the same area; dissolve cities/provinces from the resulting single county topology

limitations: Footprint schematic, not an administrative boundary map: small inland fragments and closed gaps are intentionally absorbed for a continuous illustration.
